description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for a Git feature related to split and commit-graph functionalities. It sets up repositories, creates commits, writes commit graphs, and performs various verification and testing procedures to ensure the correctness and robustness of Git's commit-graph implementation.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: A function that reads the commit graph and compares the output with expected data to verify correctness.

methods.name: verify_chain_files_exist
methods.description: Checks if all files in the commit graph chain exist.

methods.name: corrupt_file
methods.description: Corrupts a specific byte in a given file for testing integrity verification.

methods.name: corrupt_chunk_file
methods.description: Corrupts a specific chunk within a graph file to test error detection.
